title: Sleep Quality vs Duration
population: General adult sleep-habit education; no athlete-specific effect estimates.
context: Public educational guidance, not a sleep-disorder treatment or medication instruction.
definition: Sleep quality concerns how restorative and continuous sleep feels, alongside duration.

claims.text: CDC describes good-quality sleep as uninterrupted and refreshing; enough hours alone do not establish quality.

limitations: Brief public guidance, not individualized sleep treatment or a formal evidence appraisal.
Self-reported logs cannot determine sleep-disorder causes or clinically interpret sleep stages.
No independent human or clinical review.
contraindications: Discuss recurring sleep concerns with a qualified healthcare professional; do not change medicines based on this page.
